what: QSA sparse-attention reach + sparsity, measured. 4 full-attn layers, random weights, one RX 9070 XT, chunked prefill (2048-token group-aligned chunks) + 2 greedy decodes.

ladder.failure: GPU memory access fault (Page not present) — see open_defect

unchunked_prefill_ladder.failure: host-side OOM: an unchunked prefill materialises a [rows, index_width=2051] selection; a scheduler never does this, hence the chunked ladder above

open_defect.symptom: Memory access fault by GPU node-1, Reason: Page not present, at ctx=262144
open_defect.leading_suspect: the boundary sits exactly at max_blocks = 65536 = 2^16 in the qsa_index selection kernels; nothing on the engine side changes shape across that point (the fp32 logits workspace is 2^25 elements on BOTH sides — 1024x32768 at 131072 and 512x65536 at 262144 — and the score grid is 131072 CTAs on both)
